payload.title: File:Nopcsaspondylus Skeletal.svg
payload.description_html:
Skeletal diagram of the rebbachisaurid sauropod Nopcsaspondylus alarconensis. Restored after Xenoposeidon, Histriasaurus, and Lavocatisaurus.

References

  • Mannion, Philip D. (2010) A revision of the sauropod dinosaur genus ‘Bothriospondylus’ with a redescription of the type material of the Middle Jurassic form ‘B. madagascariensis’. Palaeontology 53(2): 277-296.
  • Apesteguía, Sebastián (2007) The sauropod diversity of the La Amarga Formation (Barremian), Neuquén (Argentina). Gondwana Research 12(4): 533-546.
  • Taylor, Michael P. (2018) Xenoposeidon is the earliest known rebbachisaurid sauropod dinosaur. PeerJ 6:e5212 https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj.5212
  • Canudo, José; Carballido, Jose; Garrido, Alberto; Salgado, Leonardo (2018) "A new rebbachisaurid sauropod from the Aptian–Albian, Lower Cretaceous Rayoso Formation, Neuquén, Argentina". Acta Palaeontologica Polonica. 63:679-691. https://doi.org/10.4202/app.00524.2018
  • Dalla Vechia, Fabio M. (1999) Atlas of the sauropod bones from the upper Hauterivian-lower Barremian of Bale/Valle (SW Istria, Croatia). Natura Nascosta 18: 6-41.
